newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: GYMNASTICS-DOUNEV TO MISS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: GYMNASTICS-DOUNEV TO MISS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Olympic high bar silver medallist Krasimir Dounev will miss the forthcoming world gymnastics championships because his Bulgarian team failed to register their entry on time, officials said.
The International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) said in its July newletter that Bulgaria had sent their team's registration after the deadline and so would not be allowed to compete.
Dounev is also European champion on the high bar.
The FIG said a record 66 countries would take part in the world championships in Lausanne, which run from August 31 to September 7.
